narrative.intro: Fedex Supply Chain Distribution System obligated $405M in FY26 to date. Fedex Supply Chain Distribution System won 13 federal awards during the period, with an average award size of $31.2M. Fedex Supply Chain Distribution System obligations are up 6.3% year over year. Fedex Supply Chain Distribution System obligations rose steadily from $254M in FY21 to $405M in FY26, passing $253M in FY22, $293M in FY23, $342M in FY24, and $381M in FY25. Fedex Supply Chain Distribution System shows growth in contract activity based on the fiscal-year series and the current-year totals being partial. Fedex Supply Chain Distribution System recorded multiple awards large enough to produce a $31.2M average award size, reflecting a small number of high-value awards among the 13 obligations reported in the period.
